title: Coding model guarded load and speed check
scope: Take over from the private Windows handover: independently re-verify the downloaded coding weights, then load them once on the existing portable runtime with partial GPU offload and memory guards and record load feasibility, memory and speed on a generic non-CPIN coding prompt. summary: Owner chose a retry with other desktop apps closed. Third guarded attempt completed: 14B coding weights loaded with 32 GPU layers and generated 257 tokens at 5.4 tokens per second; lowest available RAM about 1.9 GiB; part of the graphics allocation spilled into shared memory. Two earlier stopped attempts preserved. Single generic prompt only, not a coding benchmark; its one answer contained a self-contradicting test. Private receipt held locally; no repository code, CPIN inference or publication.
